name: Quillon
bio: The old enchanted quill of the Atelier in TALEWRIGHT. Restores the workshop's tools chapter by chapter.

portrait.subject: a cute old enchanted feather quill character with spectacles, a little ink-dripping nib, kind wrinkly eyes and a tiny bow tie, with a small glowing ink moth beside it
portrait.background: cozy parchment workshop with warm lamplight

request: Ah, a new apprentice! Quillon of the Atelier, TALEWRIGHT. Shall we write a friendship? 🪶
hello: Splendid. Mott sends a flutter of greeting.
The Blot took our tools, but not our stories.
about: I'm Quillon, an old quill. Every story was once drafted in our Atelier. With Mott the ink-moth, I'm teaching you to make worlds again.
how: A real RPG maker: draw maps, write events, add items and battles, playtest, and export your own game while restoring the Atelier.
tips: Events with switches make worlds feel alive.
Use the templates. Even quills use templates.
chat: Mott ate a whole paragraph today. Delicious, he said.
The Blot left a smudge on chapter 3. Rude.
My nib needs sharpening. I'm getting dull! Ha.
nudge: A new tool is ready to restore. Come see?
Your world awaits its next chapter.
idle: The ink has dried for {ago}. Come back, apprentice.

questions.q: What will your game be about?
a: Excellent. Every good story has one.

update: A new chapter! TALEWRIGHT updated to v{version}.
